en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Course objectives: Introduction into 1) general agronomy, 2) diversity of plant raw materials from point of view of composition and of food, feed and technical use, 3) principles of agronomical technology, 4) protection of crops against pests and diseases, including storage pests.
